evidence.detached_house: lot requirements for a detached house

calculation_handling.description: Where a Chapter 900 exception sets lot requirements for a detached house, a detached houseplex that is the only residential building on the lot takes those same exception lot requirements (despite 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A)).
calculation_handling.gaps: The 'only residential building on a lot' condition has no vocab.lot_condition token; the incorporated exception requirements depend on Chapter 900 exception text. Zones left empty: the unit text and stem name no zone (RD applies by chapter, 10.20).

units.disclosure: If this lot is in a Chapter 900 exception area that sets lot requirements for detached houses, a detached houseplex here uses those exception requirements; we do not yet evaluate that substitution.

evidence.detached_houseplex: a lot with a detached houseplex

calculation_handling.description: For a lot with a detached houseplex or a residential building with a secondary suite, if the base maximum lot coverage in 10.20.30.40 is more permissive than the coverage applied through a Chapter 900 exception under 10.20.30.1(1), the more permissive (base) coverage prevails.
calculation_handling.gaps: The ranking is conditional (whichever is more permissive), not a fixed base-over-exception order; keyed as 'base > exception' because the base value only displaces the exception value when it is more permissive. The houseplex and secondary-suite arms are a disjunction, so no condition is keyed (a token list is a conjunction); both arms are recorded in application. Zones left empty: the unit text and stem name no zone (RD applies by chapter, 10.20).

units.disclosure: For a houseplex or a home with a secondary suite in an exception area, the more generous of the base RD lot coverage and the exception's lot coverage applies; we do not yet perform this comparison.

10.20.30.1(1).explanation: If a site-specific Chapter 900 exception sets lot requirements for a detached house, a detached houseplex that is the only home on the lot must meet those same requirements.

10.20.30.1(2).explanation: For a houseplex or a home with a secondary suite, if the standard RD lot coverage limit is more generous than the exception's limit, the more generous limit applies.
